name: Nissa Firestone
summary: Above Ironforge’s Great Forge, Nissa Firestone teaches field medicine to travelers and soldiers.

sections.title: A Healer Above the Anvils
sections.body: Nissa Firestone tends patients upstairs in the Ironforge Physician shop. The Great Forge’s clang and heat reach her there, while she binds their wounds. Dwarven warriors can endure much, yet blades and claws still break their skin. Before travelers and soldiers set out into Dun Morogh’s snows or farther afield, Nissa teaches basic bandaging and field dressings. These skills can help keep them and their allies alive.

sections.title: Triage and Advanced Trauma
sections.body: Nissa Firestone teaches field medics how to use cloth and lint. When she has taught all she can, she directs them to specialized triage officers in distant outposts. Skilled healers go where Alliance casualties are heaviest.

faq.answer: Nissa Firestone is a dwarf who teaches first aid at the Ironforge Physician shop on the Great Forge’s southern perimeter.

faq.q: Where can I find Nissa Firestone?
faq.answer: Nissa Firestone works upstairs in the Ironforge Physician shop, on the southern edge of the Great Forge ring in Ironforge.
Nissa Firestone teaches Alliance adventurers First Aid, including how to prepare bandages and antidotes for injuries in the field.
No. When a medic reaches advanced proficiency, Nissa directs them elsewhere through the Alliance Trauma assignment, toward seasoned field surgeons near active war zones.

angles.text: As a dwarf returning from a skirmish with troggs or frost trolls, you find in Nissa the practical, no-nonsense tradition of Ironforge medicine.
As an Alliance adventurer passing through Khaz Modan, you can learn essential ways to survive from trainers like Nissa, without divine or arcane magic.
